{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and conversions
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
conversions = loyal_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = conversions / n_loyal

# Print all values to ground the evidence
print(f'n_loyal = {n_loyal}')
print(f'conversions = {conversions}')
print(f'conversion_rate = {conversion_rate}')"}
